schema.description:
Fetch a web page and return its readable text (truncated if long).

Use to read a specific page, typically a URL from web_search results.
Do not use to discover pages (use web_search) or for non-http(s) URLs.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to read.
url.title: Url

schema.title: fetch_url

schema.description:
Search the knowledge base. Returns numbered passages, each with title and source URL.

Use to answer questions from the curated knowledge base, and cite the URLs you use.
Do not use for live web facts (use web_search) or to query tables (use sql_query).

k.description: How many passages to return (1-10); omit for the configured default.
k.title: K

query.description: What to look up in the knowledge base, phrased as a focused search query.
query.title: Query

schema.title: kb_search

schema.description:
Run one read-only SQL query and return the rows as a Markdown table.

Use for exact counts, lists and lookups over the connector's tables.
Do not use to change data (writes are refused) or for free-text search (use kb_search).

sql.description: Exactly one read-only SQL statement (usually SELECT); no ';'-separated statements. Unqualified table names resolve in the connector's schemas.
sql.title: Sql

schema.title: sql_query

schema.description:
Search the web. Returns numbered results with URL, title and snippet.

Use to find candidate sources or current facts you do not already have.
Do not use to read a page you already have a URL for (use fetch_url), or
for questions you can answer from the conversation.

query.description: What to search for, phrased as a focused web search query.
query.title: Query

schema.title: web_search
